headlineSource: iTunes lookup ratings aggregate, all storefronts

reviews.author: GuiloLac
reviews.title: Opus support is broken
reviews.body:
When trying to open an Opus file, app keeps buffering and will refuse to play any kind of other file after that.

Great app otherwise

reviews.author: albertasky
reviews.title: Great App
reviews.body: Great job on this app! Smooth on Mac OS and iOS; feels very native. Especially love the lyrics being accessible. Keep up the great work on this; super impressed.

reviews.author: Lex is the happiest
reviews.title: The best
reviews.body: The best Navidrome client for Apple devices

reviews.author: Tecsharp
reviews.title: Exccelent app
reviews.body: It’s an excellent app. I’ve been testing it, and I haven’t experienced any freezes or issues so far. The app feels very smooth, and I was especially impressed that it supports both production and local links. That was really great to see. For now, it’s definitely meeting my needs.

reviews.author: TiagoM05
reviews.title: Spotify Killer
reviews.body: Been using NaviBeat for a while since I decided to leave Spotify and curate my own music server. I tried other free alternatives but either the UI wasn’t up to standard or the system was too buggy. NaviBeat found a perfect middle ground with modern clean look and a polished finish that makes the user experience so smooth. Thank you for your work Nenad!

reviews.author: notimpressed
reviews.title: Frequently fails to stream
reviews.body:
NaviBeat often hangs on “Buffering” when trying to stream. I’ve changed all the settings related to streaming quality but I can’t seem to shake the dreaded “Buffering.” Doesn’t matter whether I’m on WiFi at home or cellular.

I’ve got both my local IP and public domains setup correctly. I’ve used other Subsonic apps in the same locations, on the same networks, and with the same server and they’ve all streamed perfectly.

Also, download speeds are absurdly slow, like under 1 MB/s when I’m on the same network as my server.

reviews.author: akirichev
reviews.title: Lightweight music app for all your Apple devices
reviews.body: A lightweight, but packed with functionality Subsonic client that is nicely integrated with the devices from the Apple Ecosystem. It offers a seamless experience by offering to continue listening the queue from another device you left behind. Really nice feature is the integration with Last.fm that magically create infinite queue after your has ended.

reviews.author: gzwi'ck
reviews.title: Multiple account support
reviews.body:
The interface is polished, the audio features are excellent, but, there is one major limitation, I can’t save multiple Navidrome user accounts and quickly switch between them.

I use different accounts on the same server, each with its own libraries, playlists and permissions. Having to disconnect and enter the credentials again every time I want to switch users is quite inconvenient.

It would be great to have an account switcher that lets you save multiple users for the same Navidrome server and switch between them instantly, without logging out and re-entering credentials.

reviews.author: inkaroo
reviews.title: amazing
reviews.body: I’m setting up a home server for the first time with no experience. This app gave me zero issues in connecting and is insanely clean and runs smooth. so cool and def worth the cost!

reviews.author: Kenlst1
reviews.title: 個人體驗和功能改善和建議
reviews.body:
整體來說 這個軟件算那麼多同類型軟件最好用。但還有以下建議：
1. 增加多曲目點選按鈕，可以批量收藏 / 刪除 / 下載 
2.  發現無法顯示播放紀錄 不知道是不是Bug 
3. 關於歌手信息有時候會識別錯誤，建議增加手動修正或者其他方法可以改正，因為顯示錯誤的歌手資料很痛苦。
4. 下載項目頁面也是沒得多選 ，不能批量刪除。
5.可以在專輯 名稱下面顯示專輯品質 例如 Hi res / 44.1 lossless 
6. 專輯封面可以增加用戶自行上傳按鈕

reviews.author: cdransf
reviews.title: Excellent Navidrome client
reviews.body: A fully-featured, rapidly developed and altogether outstanding client for Navidrome and other Subsonic servers. It supports everything I need on every device and the developer is kind and responsive.

reviews.author: マキマ「支配の悪魔」
reviews.title: Broken Artworks on iOS
reviews.body:
The app is generally good, which is why I am going for 3 stars. Unfortunately, on iOS the artwork of musics gets stretched/broken whereas on MacOS it looks okay.

No idea where this difference comes from, but when that gets fixed I will definitely change the review.

reviews.author: OConstantine
reviews.title: Не плохо 👍
reviews.body: Пол дня по ходил прослушивая музыку в целом мне нравится. Но есть одно замечание буферит через два три трека mp3, FLAC, без разницы.  Интернет LTE вроде стабильный. Со стороны сервера и прокси обратного все максимально оптимизировано путем добавления заголовков. Обратите внимание на это пожалуйста. А так пока на первый взгляд все нормально еще бы добавили заголовок идет тримминг или кэш.

reviews.author: laristein
reviews.title: Almost perfect tvOS client
reviews.body:
The app is beautiful, snappy and offers just about everything I expect from a tvOS client. The only thing that’s a probably a bug is, on the Library tab, the sub-tab (Albums, Favorites etc) cannot be reached via navigation. It skips to the selection instead, so it is basically impossible for me to explore the library that way.
Overall, great app

reviews.author: moousq
reviews.title: Красивая картинка, кривая реализация
reviews.body: С стороны выглядело как ультимативное решение для задачи работы на apple tv, в реальности крайне не удобный, не логичный UX, специфичный UI, много кривых элементов и спорных дизайн решений. Багов с запасом, пользоваться поиском невозможно, вернутся из части меню невозможно, радио не удаляется, и таких моментов очень много. В общем и целом разочарован, своих денег не стоит.

reviews.author: Tijs72
reviews.title: Amazing Feature Set
reviews.body: Including offline playback on my Apple Watch! Nice UI. No subscription model. Multiple Server support. This app has it all. Impressive.

reviews.author: 夜里磨刀
reviews.title: 好用，可惜手表版有容量限制
reviews.body: 有可能让手表下载超过2.2G的歌曲吗？

reviews.author: SUYBDSUVYBSDUVYBS
reviews.title: Cumbersome design
reviews.body: Somewhat bizarre navigation design on tvOS. Navigating through your library “artists” or “albums” requires selecting the library tab first, instead of being a normal menu item. Then if you play an album, you are kicked to the “now playing” menu and have to navigate back to library to browse other items. Why would you not just stay in library tab like every other media player?

reviews.author: Rtr8
reviews.title: Very great!
reviews.body: Every update is meaningful to an already well designed app. It’s clearly a labor of love and it shows. Excellent.

reviews.author: RezaDxD
reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.body: Beautiful ui on ios, so smooth, also on tvos, imp its just need a some tweaks on tvos menu navigation like negates unnecessary click when choosing artist/album on library…

reviews.author: Dan8787
reviews.title: Excellent Software
reviews.body: Apps works super quick to browse and view your library. Simple to figure out and use. Music plays fast and the UI looks great.

reviews.author: Fyrekcaz
reviews.title: Great Navidrome App!
reviews.body: It isn’t perfect but is by far my favorite app for macOS that connects to Navidrome. At the time of writing the app is still super new and I’m confident the features it lacks will be added over time — what exists currently works great. Worth the price.

reviews.author: Solid_Inception
reviews.title: Amazing app for navidrome music library!!
reviews.body: I don’t leave many reviews for apps. This app is great. I just downloaded it today, but I love its UI/UX. It has great touches like shuffling only liked music! I have tried free navidrome client apps and they are okay, but trust me, you will not regret paying for this. I haven’t tried it with car play yet, but I hope it works with it and shows the app icon in car play, if it doesn’t I hope the developer gets that added soon.  Keep up the great work!

reviews.author: AA-2109
reviews.title: Promising app
reviews.body: Great app, but a lot of bugs, looks really awful on iPhone Mini and Apple Watch. On Mac it is better, but still a lot of visual glitches

reviews.author: kazigk
reviews.title: Terrible experience on tvOS and CarPlay
reviews.body: iOS app works ok. tvOS version is absolutely terrible - feels like the UI was not adjusted at all for tvOS, there’s no way to refresh the library without closing the app through the App Switcher and opening it again. It also incorrectly handles albums with multiple CDs. When connected via CarPlay, it skips songs whenever there are any connectivity issues, or stops working altogether. I mostly listen to my music in my car or in my living room, so unfortunately this app doesn’t really work for me.

reviews.author: AghaSLM
reviews.title: İyi ama geliştirilmesi gerek
reviews.body: Apple tv için satın aldım. Apple tv için en iyi uygulama.  Satın almışken iphondada test edelim dedim. Mobil versiyasının geliştirilmeye ihtiyacı var. Play ve shuffle butonları doğru gözükmüyor. Ümumilikde tasarım sorunları var. Tasarım iyileşse çox iyi olur

reviews.author: Bruger001
reviews.title: Awesome App
reviews.body: Awesome app with great features. Only thing missing would be an equalizer.

reviews.author: aribnch
reviews.title: Un bon début
reviews.body: Bonne application dans l’ensemble mais qui souffre de quelques lacunes par rapport à la concurrence. Certaines choses dans l’interface peuvent être contre intuitives, l’absence d’une option de téléchargement automatique pour des playlists (à chaque fois qu’une playlist est mise à jour, les titres ajoutés ne sont pas téléchargés automatiquement, il faut aller dans la playlist et le demander à chaque fois). C’est dommage car il y a des fonctionnalités intéressantes sinon.

reviews.author: Chancherito
reviews.title: It’s perfect
reviews.body: Everything works perfectly, UI is slick. Love it!

reviews.author: Gilzuma
reviews.title: Connects perfectly
reviews.body: Works exactly as it should. I can’t believe how long it took to find the app in the App Store. Apple seems to be burying one of the best apps for Navidrome. Works on each device perfectly, I’m able to easily use it with TailScale as well. Definite purchase in my book!  Thank you!

reviews.author: gru3zi
reviews.title: No Zoom
reviews.body: With a large screen its almost impossible to use as the text is too small and I can’t zoom in and out with a simple mouse scroll

reviews.author: Benicchio
reviews.title: Promising, but needs a couple of features
reviews.body: The integration with Last.FM is very interesting and the availability in every device with one purchase is great. But the app misses a couple of key features IMO: more customization options (at least for the Home tab items), connecting to more than one server and cache options on mobile devices.
